name: Phoenix Wright: World Of Justice
source: Phoenix Wright: World Of Justice is a Phoenix Wright fangame whose Casemaker is PWLib. The storyline is by Prosecutor Manella, and a scripter will be decided at a later point. It will consist of 5 cases.
translation: 《Phoenix Wright: World Of Justice》是一部《逆转裁判》同人游戏，采用PWLib制作。故事由Prosecutor Manella负责，脚本编写者尚待确定。游戏将由5起案件组成。
